content.short: Index Coop is a decentralized community that builds and manages crypto index products for simplified investing.
content.description: Index Coop is a pioneering decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) focused on creating accessible and high-quality crypto index products. By simplifying the process of diversified investing, Index Coop enables users to gain broad exposure to various sectors of the crypto market, such as DeFi, NFTs, and Layer 1s, through a single token. The community collaborates with leading financial experts to design and manage institutional-grade indices that are fully transparent and on-chain. Index Coop represents the next evolution of asset management, where community-driven governance and innovative financial engineering democratize access to sophisticated investment strategies in Web3.
content.meta: Index Coop builds and manages decentralized crypto index products, offering simplified and diversified investment exposure for global users.
